IS 5508 : Part 23 : 2024 Textiles - Fishing Gear - Guide - Part 23 26.8 Metre Two Seam Trawl
ICS 65.150
ICS 65.150
TXD 18
TXD 18
1 SCOPE
1.1 This standard (Part 23) prescribes guidelines for the construction of 26.8 m two seam trawl. It is suitable for a vessel having an overall length of 20 m to 28 m and a power from 600 hp to 700 hp.
1.2 It is used to catch Perch, Catfish, Pomfret, Lactarius and Elasmobranchs species of fish.
2 REFERENCES
The standards given below contain provisions which, through reference in this text, constitute provision of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision, and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent edition of these standards.
